text:
Maya (CS): Hey team — AegisHealth just asked for DPA evidence specifically for their non-prod/sandbox environment + confirmation of temporary access and deletion windows. They need a timeline for our response by EOD PT.
Tom (Security): tagging @Priya and @Jules — quick Q: do we treat Dedicated non-prod pools same as hosted non-prod for evidence? Aegis says they're on Dedicated reserved capacity.
Priya (Legal): We need a short scope statement for them: what counts as non-prod, any shared infra, and BYOK status. I can draft language but need a list of artifacts.
Ari (Solutions): From ops side: artifacts we can provide: access control list export, short-lived token rotation logs, example S3 deletion job run, and the onboarding checklist. Customer specifically asked about retention for embeddings generated in sandbox.
Jules (Eng): For Dedicated non-prod it's still customer-isolated but backups might be different. I can pull retention config and the deletion job. I can also export KV cache flush logs.
Maya (CS): Can someone confirm a minimal evidence bundle we can share (zip) that Legal is comfortable with? Customer wants things they can feed to their vendor-risk portal (PDFs and CSVs preferred).
Priya (Legal): Minimal bundle = scope statement (1-pg), ACL export (CSV), rotation evidence (screenshots + log snippet), deletion job run output (timestamped), and our DPA excerpt showing non-prod clause. Also a signed cover email.
Tom (Security): I'll add an ops checklist entry: emergency revocation steps + contact. Also note: for BYOK we need KMS attestation (not full keys).
Jules (Eng): I can assemble logs. I'll run the extraction and upload to secure evidence-bucket, then ping evidence-bot to generate a presigned link. ETA 4 hrs.
Maya (CS): Perfect. Can you include a short note describing how embeddings are pseudonymized in non-prod? Customer flagged that as a risk.
Jules (Eng): Yes — will include the pseudonymization step and the sample SQL we run to strip PII. Snippet: ```UPDATE embeds SET text_hash = sha256(text) WHERE env = 'sandbox';```
Ari (Solutions): Also note we rotate sandbox keys every 24h and expire tokens after 1h. I'll include a screenshot of the rotation dashboard.
Priya (Legal): Once bundle is ready, I'll attach the scope statement and sign the cover note. We should avoid including any raw PII or customer data — redact if present.
Jules (Eng): Uploaded to s3://evidence-prod-uploads/4290123456/aegis-nonprod-evidence.zip (internal path). evidence-bot, can you generate an expiring share link and checksum?
evidence-bot: Generated presigned link: https://evidence.example.com/p/eyJ-abc123 (expires in 7 days). SHA256: 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08
Maya (CS): Sent to customer with cover note and timeline. They replied asking if deletion is automated after 30 days in sandbox.
Tom (Security): Confirmed: sandbox embeddings retention policy = 30 days auto-delete. I'll attach the retention policy doc.
Maya (CS): Customer accepted the evidence bundle and requested one small change — add a line about emergency data exports being gated by approvals.
Priya (Legal): Added approval flow language. Sent revised bundle.
Maya (CS): Closing loop — customer marked as happy. Recording the deliverable in the account playbook and renewal risk tracker. Thanks everyone :tada:
Jules (Eng): Quick note for follow-up: add automation to include a redact-check step before any evidence bundle generation. Filing a small ticket.
Ari (Solutions): I'll own the runbook update.
Maya (CS): Awesome. Marking this thread resolved.
